blocks.text: Yeh enzymes DNA mein nucleotides ke khaas silsilon (sequences) ko kaat'te hain, is liye inhein molecular scissors (molecular qainchi) bhi kehte hain. Restriction endonuclease ki bohat si qismein hain. Har qism DNA mein nucleotides ka aik khaas silsila pehchanti hai. Is silsile ko restriction site ya recognition region (pehchan ki jagah) kehte hain. Enzyme DNA ke saath isi silsile par jurta hai aur is site ke andar aik muqarrar jagah se DNA ko kaat deta hai.

blocks.alt: Lamba DNA duplex jis par do recognition sites hain: oopar wale strand par GAATTC aur neeche wale par CTTAAG. Teen-kone nishan har strand par G aur A ke darmiyan kataai dikhate hain. 'Action of enzyme' wala sabz teer teen tukron tak jata hai: darmiyani tukre ke dono siron par aik-strand wale AATT ubhaar hain aur kinare wale tukron par in se milte ubhaar.

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Restriction endonucleases is liye qeemti hain ke aik hi restriction endonuclease se bane koi bhi do DNA tukre aapas mein jore ja sakte hain, kyun ke dono ke sticky ends aik doosre se milte hain.

Restriction sites mein chaar se aath nucleotides ke palindromic sequences hote hain. Palindromic ka matlab: restriction site ke aik sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke nucleotides ke complementary (jor wale) hote hain. Is liye restriction site par DNA ke dono strands mein nucleotides ka aik hi silsila hota hai, bas ulti simton (opposite directions) mein chalta hai. Restriction endonuclease dono strands se jur kar dono ko kaat deta hai. Kaatne ke baad dono DNA tukron ke sire single-stranded (aik strand wale, chand nucleotides lambe) hote hain jo sticky (chipakne wale) hain, yaani aik doosre ke complementary hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal ke taur par EcoRI enzyme GAATTC silsila pehchanta hai. Neeche wale strand par ulti simt se parhein to bhi GAATTC hi hai; yahi palindrome hai. Enzyme G aur A ke darmiyan kaat'ta hai, is liye dono tukron par AATT ke chhote aik-strand wale sire bach jate hain jo aapas mein jur sakte hain.
